title: New items overwrite existing ones after a delete
goal: No item is ever lost when another one is added.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reported: create two items, delete the first, create another; the new item takes the id of the second and replaces it. Ids must never be reused within a store.
Refused items still use up no id; a test reproduces the report.

context.notes: Find the cause and add a test that fails without the fix.
